d:
For the first Single from Panther’s upcoming Mixtape “Flying Towards the City”, Panther & Raga collaborate to present you with street anthem of the decade called “Galat Karam”. Panther produced this banger which has old school drums along with ear captivating lyricism by Panther & Raga.
Credits
Artist - Panther & Raga
Produced by Panther
Arranged by Panther, Kohar, Retro Blxxd & Nitin Randhawa
Engineered by Basspeak
Visuals
Directed & Edited by Abhay Singh
